Avval bosh pudratchi sizga ish topshiris.en: The general contractor must assign work to you first.

Foto, АОСР va laboratoriya natijasi kera.en: Add photos, AOSR and lab results in the documents section.

To‘lov ma‘lumotini bosh pudratchi ochsa.en: Payment data is shown if the general contractor shares it.

Sizga topshirilgan ishlar, bajargan hajm.en: Work assigned to you, completed volume, act and payment — in one place.

Qabul qilindi: hajm faktga bir marta yoz.en: Accepted: the volume was recorded in actuals once.

Bir ish — bitta fakt: subpudratchi hajmn.en: One job — one actual: if the subcontractor entered the volume, you do not re-enter it — accepting the act records it once.

Avval subpudratchini «Aloqalar»da taklif.en: First invite the subcontractor under “Links” (its role: subcontractor).

Bu obyektda hali ish topshirilmagan..ru: На этом объекте работы ещё не переданы.
Bu obyektda hali ish topshirilmagan..en: No work has been assigned on this object yet.

Siz bu qatorga o‘zingiz ham fakt kiritga.ru: Вы сами тоже ввели факт по этой строке: {n}. Всего не больше переданного объёма.
Siz bu qatorga o‘zingiz ham fakt kiritga.en: You also entered actuals for this row yourself: {n}. The total cannot exceed the assigned volume.

Qabul qilsangiz: hajm faktga bir marta y.ru: При принятии: объём один раз запишется в факт и добавится расход на субподряд.
Qabul qilsangiz: hajm faktga bir marta y.en: On acceptance: the volume is recorded in actuals once and a subcontract cost is added.

Ishni subpudratchiga topshiring, kelishi.en: Assign work to a subcontractor, set the agreed price, accept their act.

Akt qaytarib olindi: tahrirlab qayta yub.en: The act was withdrawn: edit it and send again.

Ulgurji summa kiritilsa, topshirilgan qa.ru: Если указана паушальная сумма, всё переданное содержимое выйдет ровно на эту сумму (распределяется пропорционально сметной стоимости).
Ulgurji summa kiritilsa, topshirilgan qa.en: If a lump sum is entered, the whole assigned content comes out to exactly that sum (split in proportion to the estimate money).
